title: hold out — remark

sentences.sentence: One prisoner was still holding out on the roof of the jail.
sentences.translation: 一名囚犯仍在监狱的屋顶上拒不投降。

sentences.sentence: This world is training workers, that there may be no shirkers in the continuous by and by.
sentences.translation: 这个世界正在训练工人，不久以后，也许不会有持续开小差的人。

sentences.sentence: I wasn't successful, so they looked down on me.
sentences.translation: 我并不成功，所以他们瞧不起我。

sentences.sentence: The peace agreement came about through intense pressure by the international community.
sentences.translation: 该和平协议是在国际社会的强大压力下产生的。

sentences.sentence: That came about when we went to New York last year.
sentences.translation: 那件事发生在去年我们去纽约时。

sentences.sentence: attempts to abolish slavery
sentences.translation: 废除奴隶制的努力

sentences.sentence: Systems engineering has been widely applied in the oilfield exploitation and construction.
sentences.translation: 近年来，系统工程学在油田开发建设中应用广泛。

粮食安全；食品安全；食物保障

sentences.translation: 这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。

sentences.sentence: lax security at airline check-in desks
sentences.translation: 登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施

sentences.sentence: terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
sentences.translation: 威胁国家安全的恐怖活动

sentences.sentence: The prison was ordered to tighten security after a prisoner escaped yesterday.
sentences.translation: 昨天一名囚犯越狱后，该监狱被勒令加强安全措施。

sentences.sentence: The Security Commission investigates breaches of security .
sentences.translation: 安全委员会对违反安全规定的事项进行调查。

sentences.sentence: We have been asked not to say anything for security reasons .
sentences.translation: 出于安全考虑，我们被要求守口如瓶。

sentences.sentence: The security forces opened fire, killing two people.
sentences.translation: 保安部队开枪打死了两个人。

sentences.sentence: The thief was caught on a security camera .
sentences.translation: 小偷被保安摄像机当场拍了下来。

sentences.sentence: There are strict security checks on everyone entering the Opera House.
sentences.translation: 每个人进入歌剧院都要接受严格的安全检查。

sentences.sentence: A large number of homes lack adequate security measures .
sentences.translation: 许多住宅都未采取足够的安全措施。

sentences.sentence: Verbal nouns have the ending -ing.
sentences.translation: 动名词以-ing结尾。

sentences.sentence: Our brows went up in surprise.
sentences.translation: 我们惊奇地竖起了眉毛。

sentences.sentence: His father stared in surprise and then burst out in tears.
sentences.translation: 他父亲惊奇地盯着他，然后便泪如泉涌。

sentences.sentence: You are an impertinent little monkey!' exclaimed Mrs Linton, in surprise.
sentences.translation: “你是一个胡闹的小猴子！” 林惇夫人惊奇地叫起来。

sentences.sentence: James broke down and wept.
sentences.translation: 詹姆斯控制不住感情，哭了起来。

sentences.sentence: He wept bitterly (= cried a lot ) when it was time for us to leave.
sentences.translation: 我们要分别的时候他痛哭了一场。

sentences.translation: 吉格斯在中线上射门。

sentences.translation: 她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

sentences.translation: 他把盘子在一摞书上放稳。

sentences.translation: 描写一家人在美国边远地区奋斗的小说

sentences.translation: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设煤气管道。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 112 单元

hold out
（在困境中）坚持
例句：One prisoner was still holding out on the roof of the jail.
一名囚犯仍在监狱的屋顶上拒不投降。

by and by
不久以后
例句：This world is training workers, that there may be no shirkers in the continuous by and by.
这个世界正在训练工人，不久以后，也许不会有持续开小差的人。

call on
要求……介入

look down on
看不起……
例句：I wasn't successful, so they looked down on me.
我并不成功，所以他们瞧不起我。

keep one’s word
遵守诺言

come about
发生
例句：The peace agreement came about through intense pressure by the international community.
该和平协议是在国际社会的强大压力下产生的。
例句：That came about when we went to New York last year.
那件事发生在去年我们去纽约时。

slavery
音标：英 /'sleɪv(ə)rɪ/  美 /'slevəri/
n. 奴隶制度
例句：attempts to abolish slavery
废除奴隶制的努力

oilfield
音标：美 /'ɔɪlfild/
n. 油田
例句：Systems engineering has been widely applied in the oilfield exploitation and construction.
近年来，系统工程学在油田开发建设中应用广泛。

security
音标：英 /sɪ'kjʊərətɪ/  美 /sə'kjʊrəti/
n. 安全
短语：social security — 社会保险，社会保障
短语：public security — 公共安全
短语：security system — 安全系统
短语：network security — 网络安全；网络安全性；网络保密
短语：for security — 为了安全
短语：national security — 国家安全；民族安全
短语：information security — 情报安全性
短语：social security system — 社会保障制度
短语：security council — （联合国）安全理事会
短语：in security — 安全地
短语：food security — 粮食安全；食品安全；食物保障
短语：security management — 安全管理
短语：security bureau — 安全局；保安局
短语：as security — 作为抵押品
短语：public security bureau — 公安局
短语：data security — 数据安全性
短语：security policy — 安全策略，安全政策
短语：computer security — 计算机安全
短语：ministry of public security — 公安部；中国公安部
短语：security guard — 保安人员
例句：The trial was held under tight security .
这场审讯是在戒备森严的情况下进行的。
例句：lax security at airline check-in desks
登机手续柜台松懈的安全措施
例句：terrorist activity that is a threat to national security
威胁国家安全的恐怖活动
例句：The prison was ordered to tighten security after a prisoner escaped yesterday.
昨天一名囚犯越狱后，该监狱被勒令加强安全措施。
例句：The Security Commission investigates breaches of security .
安全委员会对违反安全规定的事项进行调查。
例句：We have been asked not to say anything for security reasons .
出于安全考虑，我们被要求守口如瓶。
例句：The security forces opened fire, killing two people.
保安部队开枪打死了两个人。
例句：The thief was caught on a security camera .
小偷被保安摄像机当场拍了下来。
例句：There are strict security checks on everyone entering the Opera House.
每个人进入歌剧院都要接受严格的安全检查。
例句：A large number of homes lack adequate security measures .
许多住宅都未采取足够的安全措施。

ending
音标：英 /'endɪŋ/  美 /'ɛndɪŋ/
n. 结局，结尾
短语：nerve ending — 神经末梢
短语：ending point — 终点；结束点
短语：ending inventory — [经]期末存货；[经]期末盘存
短语：sensory nerve ending — 感觉神经末梢
例句：Verbal nouns have the ending -ing.
动名词以-ing结尾。

in surprise
吃惊地，惊奇地
例句：Our brows went up in surprise.
我们惊奇地竖起了眉毛。
例句：His father stared in surprise and then burst out in tears.
他父亲惊奇地盯着他，然后便泪如泉涌。
例句：You are an impertinent little monkey!' exclaimed Mrs Linton, in surprise.
“你是一个胡闹的小猴子！” 林惇夫人惊奇地叫起来。

weep
音标：英 /wiːp/  美 /wip/
vt&vi. (wept,wept)哭泣，流泪
短语：weep for — 为…而哭泣
短语：weep over — 因…而哭泣；为…流泪
例句：James broke down and wept.
詹姆斯控制不住感情，哭了起来。
例句：He wept bitterly (= cried a lot ) when it was time for us to leave.
我们要分别的时候他痛哭了一场。

shoot
音标：英 /ʃuːt/  美 /ʃut/
vt&vi. (shot,shot)射击；投篮；拍摄
短语：bamboo shoot — 竹笋，笋
短语：shoot at — 力争；向…射击
短语：shoot down — 击落；驳倒，否决
短语：shoot for — 争取，为…而努力
短语：photo shoot — 摄影；专业式拍照
短语：shoot up — 射出；发芽；暴涨；迅速成长
短语：trouble shoot — 故障查找
短语：shoot out — 射出；抽出；伸出
短语：shoot the breeze — 吹牛；闲扯
短语：shoot it out — [口语]用枪来决定结果(或解决争端)
短语：shoot off — 发射；击落；抛出
短语：shoot apex — 枝条尖；苗端
短语：shoot tip — 茎尖
短语：shoot a film — 拍摄一个镜头；拍摄电影
短语：shoot an arrow — 射箭
例句：Giggs shot from the halfway line.
吉格斯在中线上射门。

unconscious
音标：英 /ʌn'kɒnʃəs/  美 /ʌn'kɑnʃəs/
adj. 失去知觉的
短语：unconscious of — 不知道；未发觉
短语：collective unconscious — [心]集体无意识
例句：She was found alive but unconscious.
她被找到时还活着，但已不省人事。

pile
音标：英 /paɪl/  美 /paɪl/
n. 堆
短语：pile foundation — 打桩基础
短语：a pile of — 一堆；很多
短语：pile in — 塞进；挤入
短语：pile up — 积累，堆放起来
短语：bored pile — 螺旋钻孔桩；填充桩；螺旋桩
短语：concrete pile — 混凝土桩
短语：pipe pile — 管桩；钢管桩
短语：pile on — 堆在…之上；使堆积在…
短语：pile driving — 打桩
短语：pile shaft — 桩身
短语：pile cap — 桩帽
短语：sheet pile — 板桩
短语：pile driver — 打桩机
短语：composite pile — 复合桩；组合桩；混合桩
短语：foundation pile — 地基桩柱；基椿
短语：pile tip — 桩端；桩头
短语：tubular pile — 管桩，管柱；管套桩
短语：compaction pile — 密实桩，压实桩
短语：pile head — 桩头
短语：steel pipe pile — 铜管桩，钢管桩
例句：He balanced the plate on the top of a pile of books.
他把盘子在一摞书上放稳。

frontier
音标：英 /'frʌntɪə; frʌn'tɪə/  美 /frʌn'tɪr/
n. 边境，边界
短语：new frontier — 新边疆；新境界
短语：frontier trade — 边境贸易
短语：efficient frontier — 有效边界；效率前缘
短语：frontier orbital — 前沿轨道
例句：a novel about a family’s struggle on the American frontier
描写一家人在美国边远地区奋斗的小说

trench
音标：英 /tren(t)ʃ/  美 /trɛntʃ/
n. 沟，壕
短语：in the trenches — ◎在第一线，在现场
短语：cable trench — 电缆沟；电缆槽
短语：trench cover — 沟盖板
短语：trench warfare — 堑壕战
短语：trench coat — n. 军用防水短上衣
短语：pipe trench — 管沟
例句：Workers dug a trench for gas lines.
工人们挖了一条沟来铺设煤气管道。

representative
音标：英 /reprɪ'zentətɪv/  美 /'rɛprɪ'zɛntətɪv/
n. 代表
短语：representative of — 表示；代表……的
短语：representative office — 代表机构；办事处
短语：legal representative — n. 法定代理人
短语：sales representative — 销售代表
短语：authorized representative — 受权代表
短语：chief representative — 首席代表，主要代表
短语：resident representative — 居民代表；驻地代表
短语：representative sample — 代表性样本
短语：trade representative — 贸易代表；商务代表
短语：permanent representative — 常驻代表；常驻大使
短语：customer service representative — 客户服务代表，顾客服务代理人
短语：representative government — 代议政府
短语：representative democracy — 代议民主
短语：representative value — 代表值
短语：customer representative — 客户代表
短语：house of representative — 众议院
短语：authorised representative — 授权代表
短语：marketing representative — 市场代表，销售代表；营销代表
短语：corporate representative — 法人代表
短语：representative institution — 代议制机构
例句：a union representative
工会代表

greet
音标：英 /griːt/  美 /ɡrit/
vt. 问候，迎接，致意
短语：greet something with something — 对某事作出某种反应
例句：Belinda greeted her warmly.
贝琳达热情地招呼她。

remark
音标：英 /rɪ'mɑːk/  美 /rɪ'mɑrk/
vt. 说起，谈到
短语：remark on — 评论；谈论；议论
例句：‘This house must be very old,’ he remarked.
“这幢房子一定很古老了。”他说道。
